resources.string: Discover consenting VAANI users directly over Bluetooth. Both users must start mesh. This is one-hop discovery, not multi-hop message relay.
Your local profile is ready for future account linking. Google sign-in is not connected yet; it will populate this profile without exposing account credentials.

Starting makes your chosen name and enabled details readable by nearby Bluetooth devices. Profiles are self-reported and not authenticated. Mesh stops when you leave this mesh panel or the app is no longer visible.
Mesh active • profile refresh about every 10 seconds
Allow Nearby devices and precise location for this location-capable discovery feature. Granting location permission does not share your coordinates; only the separate sharing checkbox does that.
Bluetooth is off. Enable it and start again.
This phone does not support the required Bluetooth LE scan, advertising and GATT server capabilities.
Turn on location services for this location-capable nearby discovery feature.
Bluetooth advertising failed. Stop other Bluetooth sessions and try again.
Bluetooth scanning failed. Wait a moment and try again.
Mesh could not start. Check your profile, permissions and Bluetooth, then try again.
Enter a name of 1–48 characters and valid optional phone/email contact details.
No participating users found yet. Nearby phones must open VAANI and start mesh too.
Location not shared or no fresh fix available
